T3_link = stage3_local_analysis/out/nomination_funnel.csv with rule ax1_directional & ax2_selective & ax3_celltype_robust; T3_repair = stage3_repair_analysis/out/nomination_funnel.csv with the same rule; the retired ax4_tier1 is not applied on either arm. entry condition: this arm's universe is the Diagnosis n Relapse eRegulon-name intersection of the link vocabulary (686 n 793 = 431), re-verified set-identical to the funnel index on 2026-08-20 with 0 exceptions; entry condition: this arm's universe is the Diagnosis n Relapse eRegulon-name intersection of the repair vocabulary (332 n 352 = 201), re-verified set-identical to the funnel index on 2026-08-20 with 0 exceptions. background_regulons, orientation and targets carried over VERBATIM from replication/out/module_definition.json (link vocabulary) and replication_repair/out/module_definition.json (repair vocabulary), kept SEPARATE and labelled by arm -- never averaged or merged. Membership fields and target_set_sizes recomputed by modules/scripts/m_00_module_definitions.py on 2026-08-20.
frozen: 2026-08-20, frozen before any downstream statistic (replication scoring, external-cohort scoring, figures, manuscript numbers) was recomputed under the retired-ax4 redefinition. Replaces, and does not extend, the retired 'T4_tier1_core' modules in replication/out/module_definition.json (26r/14TF) and replication_repair/out/module_definition.json (34r/21TF), both retained unmodified for audit.
tf_level_note: LEVEL MATTERS -- DO NOT CONFLATE. This module is defined at the REGULON level: 13 regulons, which happen to carry 8 distinct TFs. `TFs` above is that 8-TF list and is the module's TF list. Separately, the TF-LEVEL intersection of the two T3 TF lists is 14 TFs; it is recorded below as a reported statistic ONLY and is NOT the module. The two differ because 6 TFs (CEBPA, CEBPD, MAFF, MBD2, WT1, XBP1) appear in both T3s only through NON-MATCHING sign modes, i.e. no single regulon name of theirs is in both T3s.
T5_note: RETIRED AXIS -- empty by decision, not by accident. The old link definition's `T5_subset_reference_only` held the 10 regulons that passed the ENCODE/K562 ChIP axis (`survives_all5` = ax1&2&3&4&5); they had already FAILED the internal strictest null (null C). Two independent reasons not to carry that membership into a post-ax4 module: (i) DA46 (2026-08-13) dropped the ChIP axis from the manuscript, and it was never computable on the repair arm (no gate_malig_{stage}_repair_K562_w5000.csv exists, so s3r_22_nomination.py sets ax5=False for every repair regulon by construction); (ii) `survives_all5` is ax4-CONDITIONED, so importing it into a module defined to be ax4-free would smuggle the retired axis back in. The key is retained with an empty list so the JSON schema stays identical for existing readers. The historical 10 remain recoverable from replication/out/module_definition.json and from stage3_local_analysis/out/nomination_funnel.csv (`survives_all5`).
